guitar.evidence: Thomas Raggi frequently plays Gibson Les Pauls live, but not tied to one singularly iconic instrument.

tone.target: aggressive Plexi crunch with light fuzz bite and wah accent
tone.profile: aggressive Plexi crunch with light fuzz bite and wah accent
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain starting with a boost/overdrive for grit, followed by a wah filter, leading into a classic British Marshall style amp model (UK 45) to achieve the desired aggressive Plexi crunch. Minimal reverb is used for space.
corrections: make fuzz more explicit than overdrive

rig.name: Måneskin - ZITTI E BUONI - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide initial mid-gain push and tighten the attack for crunch.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate an aggressive boost/overdrive stage before the main amp, fulfilling the 'overdrive into crunch' requirement.

alternatives.reason: A dedicated overdrive pedal could also achieve this initial grit.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required nasal wah sweep accent.
Add the specified slight fuzz grit and bite without muddying the core crunch.
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is chosen over full Fuzz/Distortion to keep the tone aggressive but controlled, matching the 'slight fuzz grit' requirement.

alternatives.reason: Too heavy and might obscure the Plexi crunch.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Plexi/Marshall tone for aggressive crunch and bright upper mids.

alternatives.reason: Similar British tone, but UK 45 is more classically associated with the Plexi sound.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound to complement the UK 45 amp model.
Sculpt the upper mids and overall frequency response for maximum bite and clarity.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to better capture the aggressive, mid-focused Plexi crunch and add a dedicated fuzz stage for more explicit grit.
